preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and len(stdin.split()) == 2 and len(stdin.split()[1].split()) == n
preconditions.description: stdin consists of exactly two lines: first line is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 300000), second line contains exactly n space-separated integers representing a permutation of numbers from 1 to n.
The second line of stdin is a permutation of integers from 1 to n (each integer appears exactly once).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any((a / b) > min(a, b) and (a / b) < max(a, b) and (a / b) in permutation for a in permutation for b in permutation if a != b) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: stdout is 'YES' if and only if there exists a pair of distinct integers a and b in the permutation such that the value of a/b (usual division) lies strictly between a and b in the permutation. The permutation is the list of integers parsed from the second line of stdin.
